metadata.description: Claude Code plugins, curated and shareable

plugins.name: notebooklm-connector
plugins.description: A plugin to manage NotebookLM notebooks and query them using integrated features.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: Personal utility commands and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: vision-powers
plugins.description: Visual report generation suite: wiki analysis, diff review, plan review, project recap, fact-checking, and report management with interactive diagrams and curated design system

plugins.name: worktree-plus
plugins.description: Enhanced git worktree: base branch selection (name@base), custom branch prefix, remote tracking, selective copy/symlink for gitignored files, dirty check on removal

plugins.name: skill-creator-pro
plugins.description: Create, test, measure, and iteratively improve Claude Code skills with category-aware design, gotchas-driven development, progressive disclosure coaching, and automated description optimization

plugins.name: codex-advisor
plugins.description: Double-check layer for the Official Codex plugin — wraps every Codex interaction with Claude's independent critical evaluation. Review, adversarial, rescue, verify, research.

plugins.name: rubber-duck-tutor
plugins.description: Rubber duck tutor that combats rubber-stamping in AI-assisted workflows. Duck character (🦆) with structured question frameworks (assumptions/blindspots/tradeoffs). Auto-hooks at workflow checkpoints: plan creation, spec documents, PR/MR.

plugins.name: e2e-test-runner
plugins.description: Run E2E browser tests using natural language test definitions powered by Claude Code SDK and agent-browser with video recording

plugins.name: claw-mo
plugins.description: Manage mo markdown viewer sessions with group-based organization: auto-start, browser integration, per-project watch patterns, port isolation

plugins.name: claw-mux
plugins.description: cmux terminal integration: topology control, browser automation, markdown viewer, notifications

plugins.name: lab-harness-zero
plugins.description: [Lab] Install once, repo becomes agent-friendly. Scaffolds structure, organizes docs, enforces principles via hooks, prepares evaluator separation.
